title: PRD-23 synthetic risk input syntax

coverageMode.description: required; standalone or rider only if contract supports. Sensitivity: internal. Error: WAR_COVER_MODE_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

basePolicyOrQuoteRef.description: required for rider; compatible approved property interest. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: BASE_POLICY_INCOMPATIBLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

propertyRef.description: required; authorized property/location. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: PROPERTY_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

eligibleTerritoryCode.description: required; explicit contract-mapped geography <= 80. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: TERRITORY_NOT_APPROVED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

insuredValue.description: required; positive with explicit valuation basis. Sensitivity: financial. Error: VALUE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

perilDefinitionVersion.description: required; approved exact wording/version <= 100. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: PERIL_DEFINITION_UNAPPROVED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

authorityEvidenceRef.description: required before any live offer; reviewed carrier/commercial/legal authority record. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: LIVE_AUTHORITY_MISSING. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
